metadata.title: Lignes directrices en matière de pharmacovigilance au Cameroun (Ministère de la Santé Publique, DPML)
metadata.edition: Undated; transmitted by Lettre circulaire N° D36-75/LC/MINSANTE/SG/DPML/SDP of 16 October 2018 (16 October 2018 is a placeholder date) · Section IV industrie: 7 jours calendaires (décès, pronostic vital), 15 jours (autres effets graves), non graves trimestriellement; personne qualifiée (French)
metadata.legal_basis: Ministry of Public Health guidelines transmitted by ministerial circular; the official French text governs.
metadata.applicability: Applicants, sponsors and market authorization holders reporting ICSRs (see the PV Info ICSR rulebook for scope).

metadata_verification: Source-register metadata; dates and legal status require human verification.
limitations: English rule-based extraction; no GPT or paid API.
